utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — we could really use a hand sorting donations and checking off supplies. If you’re free, I’d love for you to join late and help wherever needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I can join late and help sort donations and check off supplies wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — could you bring a flashlight, a Phillips screwdriver, and some zip ties? If you have any spare batteries, those would help too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring a flashlight, a Phillips screwdriver, zip ties, and any spare batteries I have.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on supplies for the repair drive and note what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — that’d help a lot. I might miss a few things, so just let me know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll keep a running list and let you know what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — I’m trying to keep it organized, so I need to know what time you’d be free and whether you can help with hauling or just fixing things.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m free this Saturday afternoon. I can help with hauling and some fixing too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are you coming to the repair drive, and if so, what time should I expect you?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m planning to come, but I’m still checking around for the time. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell — just let me know when you’ve got the time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming along nicely—folks have been dropping off all kinds of useful stuff. If you’ve got anything to spare, now’d be a good time to bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a spare wrench and a couple clamps I can bring by this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be great, Gus—those will come in handy for sure. If you swing by this afternoon, I’ll make sure someone’s there to take them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. If you want, I can also ask a few neighbors to bring tools or snacks.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would be great, Quinn — please ask for tools if anyone has them, and a few snacks would help too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll ask around for tools and snacks and let everyone know about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Sam — can you confirm you’re actually free this Saturday to help?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m free this Saturday and can help with the repair drive. Just let me know what time to be there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad you brought it up, Bo — let’s get the repair drive organized and make sure everyone knows where to help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Absolutely — I’ll keep it simple and spread the word around the block.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Bo — I’ll make a quick list of needed fixes and a sign-up sheet so folks can pick what fits them best.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll pass the word along about the repair drive and make sure folks know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. I appreciate you spreading the word so everyone knows what to expect.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem — I’ll keep repeating it around the block so nobody misses the repair drive plan.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help; just remind me what’s needed and when to bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. We still need a few basic tools and some strong tape—if you can bring them by tomorrow afternoon, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—I’ll bring the tools and strong tape by tomorrow afternoon. If I forget, feel free to nudge me!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds great — I’m happy to help connect folks and spread the word about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — I really appreciate that. I’ll keep you posted on any updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course — just send me any updates, and I’ll help spread the word here.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away — neighbors usually show up when there’s a clear way to help. Want me to mention anything specific, like tools or snacks?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, please mention that people can bring basic tools if they have them — and snacks wouldn’t hurt either.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll tell everyone to bring basic tools if they can, and snacks are welcome too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs to be fixed?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. The porch light still needs a new bulb, and the loose gate latch could use a quick fix.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can take care of the porch light and check the gate latch too. Just let me know when you want me to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help line up our school schedule around the repair drive, just tell me what times you need.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s really helpful, Faye—thank you. I’ll get you the repair drive times as soon as I have the final list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course—send them over when you have them, and I’ll make the school plan fit around it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep spreading the word and repeat the plan to anyone who asks.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll do the same and point people your way if they have questions.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and a few tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d help a lot, thanks. I’m just trying to make sure we’ve got the right tools lined up and nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I can bring a hammer, screwdriver set, tape measure, and a wrench or two. If you want, I can also help make a quick checklist so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t logged any repair-drive locations yet, Rosa, but I can keep track as soon as you tell me where to go.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Opal—please start with the houses on Maple and then check the corner unit by the laundromat. I’ll keep adding locations as I hear about them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ve marked Maple houses first, then the corner unit by the laundromat. Send me the next spots as soon as you have them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, are we still on for the repair drive this week?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes—we’re still on, but let me double-check the details before I confirm anything else.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—can you let me know the time and where we’re meeting?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you help me keep track of what supplies we still need and what’s already been promised?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can keep a simple running list of what’s needed and what’s already spoken for.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is starting soon, but I’m still catching up on the details. What should I know?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think it’s coming up pretty soon, but I’ve been a bit out of the loop too. I’d check the neighborhood board or ask around for the exact details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’ll check the board and ask around. If you hear anything concrete, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this is the repair drive for the neighborhood fixes, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, that’s the one — the neighborhood repair drive for the fixes we’ve been gathering. If you want, I can tell you what’s on the list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just confirming before I sign on—what’s on the list?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That repair drive sounds helpful — what kinds of things are you hoping people bring by?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Mostly tools and small appliances, if folks have them. Anything in decent shape would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it — I’ll spread the word while I’m out and about.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I meant to check on that today; thanks for the nudge, Leo.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: No worries—just let me know if you need a hand with it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I appreciate that, Leo. I’ll swing by and see what still needs doing, then I’ll let you know where I could use a hand.
